provenance.gold_link_type: goa_annotation_reference (GAF-derived; uniprot_entry_reference rows excluded: entry-level, not per-PMID evidence)
provenance.species_note: a (term, PMID) pair annotated in several species counts once per species

protocol.doc_text: '{title}\n\n{abstract}' if title else abstract; text is self-contained -- do NOT re-prepend the title column
protocol.candidate_terms: non-empty name+definition, 2-15 distinct experimental-evidence PMIDs with abstracts in the records table
protocol.selection: seeded shuffle of 13517 candidates, greedily accept terms under a paced gold budget (union <= 240 * (accepted+1)/75), stop at 75
protocol.distractors: sampled (seed 42) from other experimental GO-evidence PMIDs present in records, to 300 docs total
protocol.qrels: score=1 for every curated (term, PMID) evidence pair; all gold docs are in the corpus
